summary: Solid test suite with comprehensive module coverage (classify, report, config, format, cli, workflow structure) and integration testing via act harness. Tests are deterministic, well-organized, and independent with good use of fixtures. Strong error scenario coverage and boundary testing. Weaknesses: some edge cases underexplored (empty collections, extreme values), act-harness complexity could be better documented, assumed fixture files not shown in provided code, and no clear explanation of how act-result.txt artifact validation works. Task requirement for 'all tests through act' appears satisfied by workflow structure + act harness design, though actual workflow YAML not provided to verify end-to-end execution.
